name: s18_exit_sequence_three
title: Three at FL350 for ERMED: build the in-trail sequence
description: Three aircraft at FL350 converge on IBALU from RUNAX and KORNO and leave by ERMED within two minutes of each other; the last is a faster wide-body. The letter of agreement asks for 10 NM in trail at ERMED. Sequence them by speed where it is enough, by a fan of vectors (same side, growing angles, the last turned first, resumed from the front) where it is not.
